mapper.select: SELECT generation_id, input_text, input_attachments, reasoning_effort, metering_basis, assistant_text, assistant_attachments, conversation_message_id, context_generation, ephemeral_ordinal, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_prompt_tokens, reasoning_tokens, provider_cost_ticks, metering_evidence, model_finish_reason, upstream_request_id, updated_at FROM ai_conversation_generation_payload WHERE generation_id = #{generationId,jdbcType=BINARY}

SELECT generation_id, input_text, input_attachments, reasoning_effort, metering_basis, assistant_text, assistant_attachments, conversation_message_id, context_generation, ephemeral_ordinal, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_prompt_tokens, reasoning_tokens, provider_cost_ticks, metering_evidence, model_finish_reason, upstream_request_id, updated_at FROM ai_conversation_generation_payload WHERE generation_id = #{generationId,jdbcType=BINARY} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation_generation_payload SET context_generation = #{contextGeneration,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ephemeral_ordinal = #{ephemeralOrdinal,jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} WHERE generation_id = #{generationId,jdbcType=BINARY} AND context_generation IS NULL AND ephemeral_ordinal IS NULL

UPDATE ai_conversation_generation_payload SET assistant_text = #{assistantText,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, assistant_attachments = CAST(#{assistantAttachmentsJson,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS JSONB), prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens,jdbcType=BIGINT}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens,jdbcType=BIGINT}, cached_prompt_tokens = #{cachedPromptTokens,jdbcType=BIGINT}, reasoning_tokens = #{reasoningTokens,jdbcType=BIGINT}, provider_cost_ticks = #{providerCostTicks,jdbcType=BIGINT}, metering_evidence = CASE WHEN #{meteringEvidenceJson,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{meteringEvidenceJson,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS JSONB) END, model_finish_reason = #{modelFinishReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, upstream_request_id = COALESCE( #{upstreamRequestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, upstream_request_id ), updated_at = #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} WHERE generation_id = #{generationId,jdbcType=BINARY} AND assistant_text IS NULL AND model_finish_reason IS NULL
